key_insight: Advanced energy management delivers modest savings in electrified Belgian homes: €82.5/year for TreeC and €116.6/year for MPC versus default-like control.
engineering_relevance: MPC offers greater bill savings, while decision-tree-based TreeC provides higher EV charge completion and smoother aggregate electricity demand.
method: Simulate 500 representative Belgian dwellings with heat pumps, electric boilers, EV chargers, and photovoltaics assigned at current adoption rates.
Compare TreeC and model predictive control against rule-based control and perfect-forecast MPC.
Evaluate 2023 operation under hourly electricity prices and a monthly peak tariff.
evidence_signal: Simulations show similar thermal comfort across controllers; TreeC achieves 93.3% EV charge completion versus 88.8% for MPC, against a 95% maximum.
watch_item: Annual savings may not justify reported EMS purchase costs of €280–680 and subscription fees of €0–360/year; results are simulation-based.
paper_title: Should Belgians Install an Advanced Energy Management System in Their Electrified Dwelling ?
